title: perf(i18n, app-shell)!: the marketplace pages' strings leave the eager language packs for a lazy `marketplace` namespace
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuUBtTWuZmgP7aDAfaaeufU6)_

Fixes #30588

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no `skills/`, `.claude/` or `docs/` text names the moved keys or teaches the pack shape (the 17 `marketplace.` hits there are `marketplace.zod.ts` and marketplace prose)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：应用市场两张页面（目录页、应用详情页）用到的文案从十个语言包里搬出，放进一个按需加载的 `marketplace` 文案包；打开市场页时才下载当前语言那一份（外加英文兜底），下载完成前页面显示原有的加载骨架，下载失败显示控制台自己的「出错了 / 重试」。Studio 软件包页也会用到的那部分文案（卸载、未加载徽标、依赖缺失与协议提示）留在语言包里不动。文字本身一个字没改。
- 为什么改：#30588。控制台首屏必载的英文语言包 `i18n-locale-en` 已到 59,951 / 60,000 gz，只剩 49 字节，挡住了 #30545、#30552 两个要加市场文案的 PR；上限不许抬。现在读数 57,003，余量 2,997（合入 main 之后的 head `54db079b`）。
- 风险与回滚：只改前端与构建分组；首屏总量 2,204,342 → 2,201,442 gz，没有新增首屏块，十份市场文案、加载器和加载框架都不在首屏。直接读语言包对象的代码（包入口的 `en`、`@object-ui/i18n/locales/CODE`）不再含被搬走的键，属 TypeScript 层面的收窄，changeset 写明了迁移。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/marketplace/index.ts`（加载与就绪判断）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplaceNamespaceGate.tsx`（页面框架）、`ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts` 的 `i18n-ns-marketplace*` 与 `marketplace-namespace-gate` 分组（为什么两组都要 `includeDependenciesRecursively: false`）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePage.namespaceGate-30588.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/marketplaceNamespaceBoundary.test.ts packages/i18n/src/__tests__/marketplace-namespace-lazy.test.tsx`，预期 14 个用例全绿（中文页先骨架后中文、从不出现英文或原始键；切换语言时不误弹示例数据横幅）。
- 需要你做的：改动约 6,600 行（41 个文件，+4,338 / −2,294）（多为十个语言文件里整段搬移），超过 3,000 行人工合并线，请在席位复核通过后批准合并。

## What changes

- **A lazy `marketplace` namespace.** `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/marketplace/CODE.ts` (ten files) are partial packs: the same shape as `src/locales/CODE.ts`, holding the `marketplace` group cut out of that pack, text unchanged (each language's pack merged with its catalogue is deep-equal to its pack at `bdbaf80c`). `index.ts` loads them through ten literal `import()`s and exports `useMarketplaceNamespace()`, `loadMarketplaceCatalogue()`, `isMarketplaceCatalogueLoaded()`, `resolveMarketplaceLanguage()` and the namespace constants. New published subpath `@object-ui/i18n/namespaces/marketplace`.
- **How a page waits.** `useMarketplaceNamespace()` reads the i18next instance react-i18next serves, works out the two catalogues the language needs (its own, `zh-CN` served by `zh`, plus `en`, the packs' `fallbackLng`), merges the resident ones into the instance deep and without overwriting (a host's own `resources` win, as they do over the packs), and answers `loading` / `ready` / `failed` with a `retry()`. It records per instance which catalogues it installed, so a host resource that spells one `marketplace.*` key does not stop the rest of that language's catalogue. A catalogue the all-ten door registered (`registerBuiltInLocales()`) is used without a fetch. A failed fetch stays failed until `retry()` (or a later mount) asks again: no loop.
- **The page frame.** App-shell's `MarketplaceNamespaceGate` wraps the bodies of `MarketplacePage` and `MarketplacePackagePage`: the existing copy-free skeleton (`MarketplaceResolving`) while loading and after a language switch, the console's resident `console.errors.somethingWentWrong` with `console.errors.tryAgain` when a catalogue cannot be fetched, the page once ready. The skeleton after a language switch unmounts the page body while the visitor stays on the page, so the frame also says when it is holding the page back (`marketplaceFrameHolding.ts`), and `SampleDataLeaveBanner`'s unmount cleanup asks it before raising the banner that follows an installer off the package page.
- **What stays in the packs.** Studio's packages page (`views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx`), outside the marketplace route, renders `MarketplaceRowActions`, `MarketplaceNotLoaded` and the `dependencyMissing` / `protocolCheckSkipped` readers. Their keys stay resident in all ten packs: `marketplace.installedAdditiveNote`, `marketplace.notLoaded.*`, `marketplace.action.uninstall|uninstalling|details`, `marketplace.uninstall.confirm|confirmNotLoaded|successInList|successNotLoaded`, `marketplace.install.dependencyMissing.*`, `marketplace.install.protocolCheckSkipped.*` (19 leaves in `en`). The new `marketplaceNamespaceBoundary.test.ts` holds that set to what those files read.
- **The all-ten door stays complete.** `@object-ui/i18n/locales` now hands out each language as its pack deep-merged with its namespace catalogue and refuses a key defined in both, so `all-locales-key-parity` and every suite walking `builtInLocales` still walk the moved keys, and `registerBuiltInLocales()` still makes every string resident. The package entry's `en` is the resident pack alone.
- **The i18n gates learn the namespace.** `check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` (`collectEnKeys`, hence `check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs` too) and `check-i18n-en-drift.mjs` read `namespaces/marketplace/CODE.ts` beside each pack, refuse a key defined in both places, and keep the namespace file optional for fixture roots. No other gate rule changed.
- **Chunking.** `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts` gains `i18n-ns-marketplace` (the loader) and ten `i18n-ns-marketplace-CODE` groups, plus `marketplace-namespace-gate` (the frame). The loader's and the frame's groups take `includeDependenciesRecursively: false`; the comment there gives the two measured reasons (the default stole `locales/registry.ts` and the preload helper into an eager loader chunk; the frame otherwise lands in the chunk the two pages share with the eager packages page).
- **Ceiling untouched.** `PER_CHUNK_GZIP_CEILINGS` and `PER_CHUNK_BASELINE` are unchanged; the new reading is recorded in prose beside `'i18n-locale-en': 60_000`. `locales/registry.ts` and the pack file names are unchanged.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/30588-marketplace-lazy-namespace.md`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, BREAKING with its migration, ADR-0087 `not-required (runtime-interface-only ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts#TranslationKeys)`.

Branch: the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-9mg01c`, not `claude/issue-30588-*`; the card is #30588.

## Tests

- New `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/marketplace-namespace.test.ts` (56 cases): ten literal `import()` loaders and no static catalogue import (read by the TypeScript parser); every catalogue holds only the `marketplace` group and the probe key, no pack holds the probe key, no leaf is in both a pack and its catalogue; the all-ten door's languages are exactly pack plus catalogue; the entry's `en` lacks the moved keys; language resolution; the loader refuses an unknown code and memoises.
- New `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/marketplace-namespace-lazy.test.tsx` (5 cases, registry re-registered as packs alone): `zh-CN` answers loading first, then every render of the probe is Chinese (no English, no raw key) and only `zh` and `en` were fetched; a switch to `ja` waits again; `sv` is served by `en`; a host resource for `marketplace.title` wins and `marketplace.refresh` still arrives in Chinese; a failing `ko` chunk answers failed once, makes no second request on its own, and `retry()` loads it.
- New `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePage.namespaceGate-30588.test.tsx` (4 cases, a MutationObserver records every text node the page adds): the catalogue page in `zh-CN` and the package page in `de` show the skeleton, then their language, and never the English text or a raw key; an `ar` chunk that fails shows the Arabic resident error words, and Try again fetches it and renders Arabic; on a package page with a sample-data record from this session, a switch from `zh-CN` to `ja` raises no banner in any language, and leaving the page raises it in Japanese. Before the frame said it was holding, that case failed: the switch raised the banner in Chinese while the installer was still on the page (`expected … not to contain '"Service Desk" 中有示例数据。'`).
- New `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/marketplaceNamespaceBoundary.test.ts` (5 cases): finds every module outside `console/marketplace/` that imports into it, holds that both pages render under the frame, and that every `marketplace.*` key spelled by a file reachable from an ungated door is a resident pack key.
- Gate tests: `scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-call-site-keys.test.ts` and `check-i18n-en-drift.test.ts` gain the namespace cases (a group moved into the namespace is no drift; a change inside it is; a key in both is refused).
- **Ablation (the dispatch's).** With the commit in place, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `MarketplacePage`'s `MarketplaceNamespaceGate` wrapper with a bare fragment (the page no longer loads the namespace): the frame test went red, 2 failed / 3, the first frame reading `expected 'marketplace.titlemarketplace.subtitle…' not to match /\bmarketplace\.[A-Za-z]/`. The same on `MarketplacePackagePage`: 1 failed / 3. Both restored by the tool's trap: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **The boundary test catches the gap it was written for.** At the packs of `69ab56e1` (before the Studio keys went back), it failed 2 / 5, naming the eleven `MarketplaceRowActions.tsx` keys.

## Acceptance notes

- **Bundle readings** (console `CI=true vite build`, `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`): `i18n-locale-en` 59,951 at `bdbaf80c` → 57,010 at `17e15c7f` (ceiling 60,000, headroom 49 → 2,990). Eager closure 2,204,342 → 2,201,442 gz, 103 → 103 eager chunks with the same names on both sides; no other chunk moved by more than 40 bytes. No `i18n-ns-marketplace*` chunk and no `marketplace-namespace-gate` chunk is eager. The ten catalogue chunks read 3,724 (`en`) to 5,048 (`ru`) gz each, the loader 1,315 gz, the frame 704 gz, all lazy. The prose beside the ceiling records 2,201,440, read at `5986ae70`; the 2 bytes are chunk-hash noise.
- **Screenshots** (live stack, console via vite): catalogue page in `zh-CN` ([shot](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/af733e30a3e6bc0e2e172de3e35638f32b21b844/evidence/30588/marketplace-catalog-zh-CN-1440.png?raw=true)) and `de` ([shot](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/af733e30a3e6bc0e2e172de3e35638f32b21b844/evidence/30588/marketplace-catalog-de-1440.png?raw=true)); package page in `zh-CN` ([shot](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/af733e30a3e6bc0e2e172de3e35638f32b21b844/evidence/30588/marketplace-package-zh-CN-1440.png?raw=true)) and `de` ([shot](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/af733e30a3e6bc0e2e172de3e35638f32b21b844/evidence/30588/marketplace-package-de-1440.png?raw=true)), 1440 wide. A Playwright run recorded every text node each page added on the way: no raw `marketplace.` key and no English title or subtitle in any of them, no page error. The language files (`zh` and `en`, `de` and `en`) were requested only once the marketplace page opened; the dev server serves the loader module itself at boot, since dev has no chunks (the production readings above are the lazy ones). Shots committed at `af733e30` and removed from the tree by the next commit; they predate `17e15c7f`, which changes only when the sample-data banner is raised.
- **Language switch while a page is open** shows the skeleton until the new language's catalogue lands, which unmounts the page body: a half-filled install dialog is lost on a switch, and the page reads its package again. Chosen over keeping the body mounted, which would show English for a moment. The one unmount cleanup in these pages that means the visitor left, the sample-data banner, checks the frame first (fixed in this PR, see Tests).
- **For #30511 / PR #30595:** that card renames packs to `zh-Hans` / `zh-Hant` / `pt-BR`; after this lands it adds the matching `namespaces/marketplace/CODE.ts` files and loader entries (the shape test pins one loader per `BUILT_IN_LANGUAGE_CODES` entry, so it will say so).
- **For PR #30545 / PR #30552:** their new `marketplace.install.preview.*` and related keys belong in the namespace catalogues, unless Studio's packages page reads them.
